purpose: Conservative Nature Class Community source export for the Assembly Code AGPL handoff.
policy: This manifest is conservative: current runtime/source code stays in the candidate Community export unless a later reviewed boundary explicitly permits exclusion.
Private development history, issue/PR history, internal research, agent configuration and internal documentation are not part of the clean source artifact.
The exporter is local-only. It never creates a repository, configures a remote, pushes or publishes.
Before public release, #525 and #1316 audit the exact exported tree, #1314 proves a clean clone, and #1315 supplies public-facing release documentation.

Outside contributions remain closed; the private repository's CLA and contributor instructions are not copied into the release candidate. A public-repository-specific contribution policy is added only after #13/legal review and a verified fail-closed identity/CLA gate.
Tests that assert on the private repository's own CI workflows, hooks, worktrees or design prototypes are excluded with their subject, so the public suite passes from a clean clone.

The public README, notices and security policy are overlays from release/community/, and every exported text file passes the denylist in docs/release/ (which is itself never exported) or nothing is written.
Images showing identifiable children, or a child's own artwork, stay out of the public tree until the founder records consent for publication (#1316).
